notes:
Summary: CodeRoost builds an IDE-embedded copilot used by engineering teams at scale. Primary pain: context window loss for large mono-repos + need for sub-100ms completion latency inside the IDE. Interested in repository-aware retrieval (embeddings + vector DB) + chunking strategy that preserves code semantics. Also needs model/version pinning for reproducible completions across releases.

Key technical requirements / quotes:
- 'We need completions to show up in under 120ms on average for single-line suggestions; streaming is a must for UX.'
- Repository footprint: ~500k files, ~120GB source (monorepo), mixed go/java/js. Expect spikey QPS during morning standups.
- Retrieval: want per-repo vector DB tenancy (data residency) — EU and NA customers must be isolated.
- Chunking: language-aware chunking (function/class level) + chunk overlap for context; hashing strategy for updates to avoid re-embedding entire repo every commit.
- Embedding cadence: incremental embeddings on commit hooks; prefer batch + real-time delta pipeline.
- Vector DB: evaluating hosted vector DB vs self-hosted (VPC tenancy) — needs TTL + retention controls for ephemeral data.
- Model constraints: pin to specific model hashes for A/B tests; fallback to smaller quantized model during load.

Sales notes / CRM shorthand:
- POC scope: 3-week — measure latencies, token cost per completion, retrieval hit-rate, and memory/KSU for vector DB.
- Cost sensitivity: cares about per-completion token cost; will trade model size for cost if retrieval hit-rate > 70%.
- Security: requires SSO + audit logs; legal insists on data residency clause for EU accounts.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Exact SLA/residency wording legal will sign (pending).
- Confirm whether customer will prefer Dedicated reserved capacity or Private VPC for final deployment.
- Need sample repo snapshot to run embedding pipeline (asked for sanitized sample).
